title: Musicians Who Are Cat Lovers: Taylor Swift, Ed Sheeran & More
summary: Kesha, MGK, Sabrina Carpenter and several other stars have also shared their feline fandom.
body: Every year, the United States recognizes National Cat Day on Oct. 29 — and there’s a good number of cat-owning musicians who have a lot to celebrate on the holiday. Some of the biggest names in pop, country and hip-hop have sassy, cuddly, playful, pointy-eared companions waiting for them at home each day, from Katy Perry to Doja Cat, Adele, Kesha and more. And then there’s Taylor Swift, who’s so obsessed with her felines, she’s incorporated them into her music multiple times — singing, “Guess I’ll just stumble on home to my cats” on “Gorgeous” and “Karma is a cat, purring in my lap ’cause it loves me” on “Karma.” A lot of stars also make their own social media accounts for their pets, allowing followers to nurture fandom not just for them, but for their animals, too. Justin Bieber’s kitties have a following of nearly 300,000 on Instagram, for example, while Ed Sheeran’s cats are close behind in numbers. title: Razer’s 11-port USB-C dock just got $50 cheaper
summary: Razer’s 11-port USB-C travel dock drops to $79.99 on Amazon, adding 4K HDMI, Ethernet, card slots, and 85W charging.
body: The Razer USB-C Dock 11-Port Travel Charging Station is down to $79.99 on Amazon right now, which cuts $50 off the $129.99 recommended retail price. That’s a 38% discount relative to the RRP, and it’s the kind of drop that makes a premium travel dock much easier to justify. See the deal at Amazon

title: Anker Prime 3-in-1 charger drops under $100 in Amazon deal

body: The Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2-Certified Palm-Sized 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger is built for Apple users who want one compact charger for an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods, and there’s a strong deal on it right now. It’s a palm-sized foldable charging station from Anker that packs travel-friendly design with premium charging features. See the deal at Amazon
